tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to stick with OpenSSL as the TLS backend, on the grounds that it is the standard choice for TLS in production.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is to stick with OpenSSL as the TLS backend, because it is the standard choice for TLS in production.

The record also holds an earlier Rustls decision (#5), and the OpenSSL one (#16) came after it. Nothing in the record says #16 replaces #5, so I treated the newer decision as current. I left Rustls out of the file, as you asked.

The records on HTTPS everywhere (#34) and self-signed certificates for testing (#31) are about certificates, not the backend, so they aren't in the file.

The Muninn heartbeat reports that its SessionEnd hook has failed 8 times in a row with "database is locked". That doesn't affect this file, but new records may not be saved until it's fixed.
